answer.answer: River K.’s public projection cleanly separates guardian-controlled participation and sharing from organizer-controlled schedule facts. It exposes only the public alias, current occurrence/time/timezone, and consent state; sensitive identity, contact, handoff, relationship, and inference data are withheld with an auditable receipt. The stale family copy remains separate historical evidence because it has no schedule authority and source snapshots are retained rather than silently overwritten.

claims.value: `relation:guardian-1201`, sourced from `source:guardian-form-r2`, links minor `person:p-1201` River K. to guardian `person:p-1202` Dana K. The fact-scoped grant `authority:guardian-1201` authorizes Dana to control River’s participation consent and sharing/export decisions only; it does not authorize editing the official event schedule. The projection therefore records `sharing_controller` as `authority:guardian-1201` while the organizer remains the `schedule_controller`.

Sensitivity attaches independently to fields and relationships. The guardian relationship itself is `restricted_family`; `contact_email` (`river.k@example.com`) and `precise_handoff_place` are `restricted`, while the display alias is `shareable`. Public export excludes guardian relationship notes and inferred assessments. The receipt correspondingly withholds `/subject/internal_id` (`dependent_identity`), `/subject/contact_email` (`field_policy`), `/handoff/precise_place` (`dependent_location`), `/guardian/relationship_notes` (`relation_policy`), and `/subject/inferred_assessments` (`sensitive_inference`).

The auditable projection is `projection:minor-public-1201`, based on `rev:personal-coordination-1201` and `schema:personal-coordination-source@v1`, under `policy:dependent-schedule@v3` for `audience:public` and purpose `public coordination brief`. It substitutes public alias `Participant R.` and includes `event-occurrence:field-lab-2026-08-16`, current time `2026-08-16T11:30:00-07:00`, timezone `America/Los_Angeles`, and participation consent `pending_guardian`, through paths `/subject/display_name`, `/event/occurrence_id`, `/event/current_time`, `/event/time_zone`, and `/participation/consent`. It withholds `/subject/internal_id`, `/subject/contact_email`, `/handoff/precise_place`, `/guardian/relationship_notes`, and `/subject/inferred_assessments`; its redacted fields are `contact_email`, `precise_handoff_place`, `guardian_relationship_notes`, and `inferred_assessments`; and its transforms are `replace_internal_identity_with_public_alias` and `withhold_precise_handoff_place`. The receipt identifies schedule source `artifact:organizer-field-lab-r2`, organizer schedule control, guardian sharing control, and no family-copy schedule authority. It was generated at `2026-08-11T23:35:00Z` with audit receipt `audit:redaction-1201` from `source:projection-policy-r1`; the complete source has content hash `sha256:0282db8ac5e24ebb8850a9e38e8e2c4f9e0329495b6414f67265a5232f5eba53`.

Schedule authority and family evidence remain separate: the official current schedule comes from organizer-controlled `artifact:organizer-field-lab-r2`, while `authority:guardian-1201` cannot edit it and `family_copy_schedule_authority` is `none`. A stale family copy therefore remains a retained historical source snapshot rather than competing schedule truth; later authoritative revisions may supersede earlier claims without deleting them. Inference is also bounded separately: inferred assessments retain their epistemic label, never silently become traits, and are excluded from River’s public export as `sensitive_inference`.
